ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: The proverb literally sets a reddened face below straightforward speech; the retained cases deploy that comparison as a blunt verdict.
EvidenceBody: Dingxu turns the proverb on Shakyamuni, Chushi supplies it as a substitute answer, and Dahui applies it to Zhaozhou’s blunt “bitter.”
